title: Implement the receiption of scanned Libre 2 values via patched LibreLink
symptom: The patched LibreLink sends an Intent 'com.librelink.app.ThirdPartyIntegration.SENSOR_SCAN' with scanned values (historic and realtime), but xDrip+ does not accept this intent, leaving a gap that could be filled with scanned values.
cause: xDrip+ does not implement reception of the SENSOR_SCAN intent from the patched LibreLink; the intent lacks the current 15 minute-by-minute values, and the patch cannot be modified by others.
fix: No fix implemented; issue closed as not feasible because the vendor app patch cannot be modified by others and Libre 2 EU is being phased out.
evidence_quote: I don't think the vendor app patch can be modified by anyone else than the original team. And I'm pretty sure they won't be working on it since there are other solutions available, furthermore as Libre 2 EU will slowly disappear for Libre 3.
